verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents some narrow rule-to-action automation. Resource monitors can be set to suspend a warehouse when it hits a credit limit, Snowpipe loads files automatically as soon as they land in a stage, and notification integrations deliver cost anomaly alerts. Streams capture DML changes "so that actions can be taken," but they are a building block, and no general user-defined event-trigger mechanism is evidenced. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined triggers that run arbitrary actions on data or system events (e.g. tasks or alerts reacting to stream changes), any AI-native or natural-language rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
